_help: THE voices for every @maddiee.makess reel (Option 3 (American teen Maddie + young British Claude), re-chosen 2026-11-11). Never change the refs: every line is cloned from them so Maddie and Claude always sound the same. Per reel: copy this file to studio/voices/<scene>.json, fill 'jobs' (one per line, emotion tags like [sigh] [laughter] [surprise-oh] [surprise-wa] [question-en] [dissatisfaction-hnn] go inside the text), run the 'voices (OmniVoice)' workflow with that config, then put the wavs in codevid/voice/<scene>/NN.wav (render.js uses them automatically).

ref_text.maddie: Hey guys, I'm Maddie. Today I'll show you something crazy I made with my robot.
ref_text.claude: Good evening. I am Claude. I write the code, and I render the whole reel.

voices.maddie_C: male, teenager, moderate pitch, american accent
voices.claude_B: male, young adult, moderate pitch, british accent
